toolchain.build: CMake/Ninja VS2022 x64 ABI Windows SDK10.0.26100.0

classification: CoreGS 1.1 candidate with owner capture (TASK-028): slice186 = slice184 adapter plus GS primitive statistics (GT4_GS_PRIM_STATS), F10 frame capture, and sprite sub-sample switches (GT4_GS_SPRITE_SUBSAMPLE, GT4_GS_SPRITE_SNAP) on by default at PS2_SCALE > 1. Shaders: slice186 derived gs.wgsl per scale.

internal_scale.frame_dumps: 1x box-average by default; GT4_DUMP_NATIVE_SIZE=1 writes the scaled image
internal_scale.window: windowed client 960x540 at scale 1; 16:9 at 448 x scale otherwise (1593x896, 2389x1344, 3185x1792), clamped to the work area of the monitor under the cursor and centred

vu1_aot.entry_policy: all: 2048 static entries of the pinned image
vu1_aot.corpus: private/slice155-vu1-full-corpus (426 recorded-layout files; the 2,048 corpus is not built into CTest)

purpose: Owner test of TASK-028 sprite and capture switches at --mode upscale: slice186 adds GS primitive statistics, F10 frame capture and two sprite switches (sub-sample coverage, no texel snap) at PS2_SCALE > 1.
status: candidate: CTest and headless controls; owner race capture pending; not merged

controls.headless_scale1: slice157 schedule, 4,200 frames, PS2_SCALE 1: 42 of 42 dumps byte-identical to private/slice157-smoke/headless-157/frames (checked on the final binary)
controls.headless_scale3: slice157 schedule, PS2_SCALE 3, GT4_DUMP_NATIVE_SIZE=1: sprite switches on vs off; 41 of 42 dumps identical; frame 900 (garage home menu) differs
controls.ctest: CTest on the slice186 build; see docs/BUILD.md slice 186 for the count and any exception

owner_launch.switches_off: set GT4_GS_SPRITE_SUBSAMPLE=0 GT4_GS_SPRITE_SNAP=1 in the environment, then the same command
owner_launch.capture: press F10 on a race scene with trees and guardrails, then F8 for the report (GT4_GS_PRIM_STATS=1 is needed for the stats lines)

coregs11_options.GT4_DEINTERLACE: auto|off|weave|bob|blend|adaptive (default auto: adaptive on really interlaced output; progressive untouched)
coregs11_options.GT4_PRESENT_FILTER: nearest|linear|fsr (default automatic: nearest at scale 1, linear when scaled)
coregs11_options.GT4_FSR_SHARPNESS: percentage 0 to 100 (default 50; 100 is sharpest, 0 softest; stops = 2 * (1 - percent/100)); FSR scales the scaled internal image (640x448 x SCALE) to the 16:9 window rectangle

gs_switches.GT4_GS_SPRITE_SUBSAMPLE: 0|1, default 1 at PS2_SCALE > 1: sprite coverage at sub-sample positions (px, py)
gs_switches.GT4_GS_SPRITE_SNAP: 0|1, default 0 at PS2_SCALE > 1: 0 = no texel snap for sprites; 1 = slice 184 snap to the integer pixel
gs_switches.GT4_GS_PRIM_STATS: 0|1, default 0: per-batch primitive statistics; printed at exit (headless) and at F8
gs_switches.GT4_GS_PRIM_STATS_TRACE: 0|1, default 0: with GT4_GS_PRIM_STATS=1 and no window, one line per display() call
gs_switches.not_implemented: GT4_GS_LINE_SUBSAMPLE: no line sub-sample coverage (lines are absent in the measured schedules; see docs/BUILD.md slice 186)
gs_switches.capture: F10 writes the next presented frame at scale and as a 1x box average (PNG) plus a stats text into the newest private/manual-play/session-* folder
